collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A child teaches an elder a new game played with pebbles and lines in the sand.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), a child, teaches an elder a new game played with pebbles and lines in the sand. The elder wins the very first round and seems surprised.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), a child, teaches an elder a new game played with pebbles and lines in the sand. The child keeps changing the rules, and the elder plays along cheerfully.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), a child, teaches an elder a new game played with pebbles and lines in the sand. They play until supper, and the elder asks to play again tomorrow.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1), a child, teaches an elder a new game played with pebbles and lines in the sand. The elder teaches the child a game from long ago in return.
